title: KILLA – BANANA ICE
description:
KILLA DRY BANANA ICE is an awesome type of nicotine pouches with a sweet cool taste and good power.

If you want a new exotic experience and like a dry aftertaste, this product is perfect for you.

We’re sure you’ve never tasted such an unusually pleasant banana flavor before

Portion size: 0,7g
Nicotine: 16mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 11.2mg
Portions per can: 20 pc.
